1.name: WINTER
1.text: January. The argument gets longer after dark.

3.name: SPRING
3.text: March. The light comes back before the conclusions do.

4.name: SPRING
4.text: April. Something outside is growing. The lecture is not.

5.name: SPRING
5.text: May. Windows open. The soundtrack leaks.

6.name: SUMMER
6.text: June. Prime time is still daylight.

7.name: SUMMER
7.text: July. The station refuses to go on vacation.

8.name: SUMMER
8.text: August. Heat is not an argument, but it acts like one.

9.name: FALL
9.text: September. School is in. So is the grid.

10.name: SPOOKY SEASON
10.text: October. The porch light is a thesis.

11.name: FALL
11.text: November. The days resign before the programs do.

12.name: WINTER
12.text: December. Cold enough to keep the set on.
